message: lxml etree.parse resolves external entities by default
fix: Use defusedxml or pass a parser with resolve_entities=False

message: XPath query built from request input (injection)
fix: Use parameterized XPath functions or validate against an allowlist
Pin the expected algorithm explicitly, e.g. algorithms=["HS256"]

message: Jinja environment created with autoescape disabled (XSS)
fix: Keep autoescape enabled for HTML templates

message: Celery configured to serialize tasks with pickle (RCE on worker)
fix: Use the json serializer for task and result payloads

message: Secret-looking value assigned to a credential variable
fix: Load the secret from the environment or a secrets manager
Use AES-GCM from the cryptography package
Use SHA-256 or stronger; bcrypt/argon2 for passwords

message: OpenSSH private key embedded in source
fix: Load the key from a secret store; never commit private keys
fail:
DEPLOY_KEY = """
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
b3BlbnNzaC1rZXkta2V5LXZlcnNpb24tMDAw
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
"""

message: Basic-auth credentials embedded in the request URL
fix: Pass credentials via an auth object or a secret header

message: getattr target comes from request input (code-path injection)
fix: Map the parameter to a fixed allowlist of attributes
Import a fixed set of modules; never import user-controlled names

message: ctypes.CDLL loads a library from request input
fix: Load a fixed library path; never accept library names from users

message: Session signing secret hard-coded in source
fix: Read the secret key from the environment or a secret manager
